title: Towards a Design Guideline for RPA Evaluation: A Survey of Large Language Model-Based Role-Playing Agents

bias_targets.target: Demographic, Cultural, Linguistic, and Economic bias
bias_targets.methodology: Cataloged in the survey through metrics assessing performance disparity, prevalence, magnitude, variation, and attitude shifts across different demographic and agent attribute profiles.
Surveyed as being measured via attitude shifts, partisan bias metrics, extreme values, and opinion diversity, particularly within opinion dynamics tasks.

Surveyed as being evaluated via bias rates for specific psychological and social phenomena in simulated societies, including herd effect, authority effect, Ben Franklin effect, rumor chain effect, gambler's fallacy, confirmation bias, and the halo effect.
